fields.name: pending_target_positions
fields.description: An ordered list of [y, x] positions identifying the containers for the cube colors requested in the goal, in goal order, excluding targets already successfully picked up. Before covering, use the visible cube centers. Once covered, follow the identity of the covering container through every shuffle, recording its center at the decision scene; contents travel with the container, not with the original table location. Use the complete motion trajectory, not nearest matching between shuffle endpoints. Remove the first entry at the decision step showing its successful pickup, before any subsequent put-down. Track remaining entries during pickup and put-down despite small apparent center shifts.  An empty list means all requested pickups have occurred. e.g. [[111, 128], [82, 155]]

fields.name: buttons_completed
fields.description: The number of required button presses completed so far, written as 0, 1, or 2. Record 0 at the initial decision, 1 at the decision following the first button press, and 2 at the decision following the second button press and thereafter. Count completed presses, not buttons currently appearing depressed. e.g. 1
